verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sārajjaṁ okkanto hoti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a mendicant with five qualities is overcome by timidity.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant is faithless, unethical, with little learning, lazy, and witless.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sārajjaṁ okkanto hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is overcome by timidity.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu visārado hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant with five qualities is self-assured.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant is faithful, ethical, learned, energetic, and wise.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu visārado hotī”ti.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is self-assured.”
